# proxmox_notification_target_test (Resource)

Sends one test notification to a notification target through `POST /cluster/notifications/targets/{name}/test`. Every change replaces the instance, destroy is a no-op.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_notification_target_test" "check" {
  name     = "mail-to-root"
  triggers = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification target name.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Values that decide when to test again.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Target name.
